notes.title: Patch 1.4.0.6 for unexpected crashes
notes.content:
Hey!

We would like to inform you that we are fully aware of the frequent game crashes that have occurred since the SteamVR 2.0 update. The title, which was previously running smoothly, experienced unexpected issues that took us by surprise. We think we've found a solution that will stop crashes from happening anymore. Our QA Team checked the title with new patch 1.4.0.6 and currently Thief Simulator VR no longer crashes on our specs. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we eagerly await your opinions on the current stability of the game. Thank you for your patience.

Join us on Discord! https://discord.gg/dERxD78

Best,
Gameboom VR Team

notes.title: Update 1.3.1.0 is available now. Performance, optimization, QoL, fixes!
notes.content:
Hey!

First, we'd like to thank you for supporting Gameboom VR! Our Cooking Simulator VR sells great, we've won the VR Game of the Year award on Steam, and now we can work on some new games for you. However, this does not mean that we are forgetting about our first game - Thief Simulator VR!

Thief Simulator VR receives another patch today, which introduces a number of improvements. The new version of the game is full of changes that improve both the performance of the game and its mechanics. Full changelog below:

Changes:
- The game is 1GB smaller
- Graphical optimization (materials, shaders, big textures)
- New functionality - you can use fast travel within one neighborhood, using the car
- It is easier to get in and start the car
- It is easier to hide in designated places (wardrobe, bed, dumpster)
- Limiting memory consumption for weaker RAM and VRAM (texture compression)
- Removal of information about too weak VRAM (textures compress automatically)
- NPC pathfinding calculations are lighter
- UI Change - Text display is less resource-intensive
- Better texture blending
- Additional info about remote grab in the tutorial
- Larger default remote grab distance
- In seated mode, the player's belt is higher
- More stable handling of quickslots on the belt
- By default, crouching is always lower than standing (seated mode)

Fixes:
- Some items were floating above the ground
- Duplicating items
- Some materials shined too much
- Removal of lag at the first breaking of the window
- Some objects were showing through the fog
- The mountains in the second neighborhood were disappearing
- The player's character does not jitter
- The tablet does not jitter while driving
- The paintings are not pixelated
- A typo in the Polish language version
- Some windows looked broken but were not
- Crowbar could not be raised
- 3 or 4 hands were rendered when the game couldn't determine if we were playing by Steam or Oculus

Join us on Discord! https://discord.gg/dERxD78

Thanks for constant support and sharing your valuable feedback!

Best,
Gameboom VR Team

notes.title: Thief Simulator VR Full Game Out Now!
notes.content:
The day has come - Thief Simulator VR is leaving Early Access and becoming the full game.

We have thanked you several times already and we want to do it again. Developing Thief Simulator VR would not be so easy without the huge support of the community. Your advice and ideas on Discord have helped us a lot, making the game better and better over time. Even now, when we are working from home through a pandemic - we feel your support and the work goes smoothly.

Thus, since the game's debut in the form of Early Access:

[list]
[*] we've made 149 minor changes to the gameplay
[*] we added a significantly better tutorial
[*] we changed the look of the inventory
[*] we have introduced new story quests
[*] players got an additional neighborhood
[*] changeable weather appeared
[*] players got the opportunity to buy a house and decorate it
[*] we added the "junkyard" location
[*] we added a new vehicle - VAN
[*] we have enabled a sitting game mode
[/list]

But today is a special day for one more reason! Our friends from the Frozen District are releasing House Flipper VR today! Therefore, we decided to cooperate and present you a special offer - buying the Thief Simulator VR and House Flipper VR bundle you will pay less!

 https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16770/

After all, the work continues, because we have more titles in production! The goal of GameBoom VR is to bring many "flat" games to VR and Thief SImulator VR was just the beginning. Work on Cooking Simulator VR is already underway, and you know we're waiting for the release of Prison Simulator.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1358140/Cooking_Simulator_VR/

Thank you,
GameBoom VR team

notes.title: New update is here! Seated mode, climbing, wind and new tutorial!
notes.content:
Hello there!

The new update adds to the game the things that we have announced some time ago. There is now a completely new tutorial in the game. For people who prefer playing while sitting - we have added the seated mode. We also added a new climbing mechanic. Also, pay attention to the new vegetation that reacts to the wind and does not make you feel dizzy!

What exactly are the changes in the game?

Changes:
[list]
[*] New Tutorial!
[*] Seated mode!
[*] New climbing mechanic!
[*] Wind!
[*] New trees that do not cause motion-sickness
[*] Anisotropic filtering is forced on for medium, high, and very high graphic quality
[*] New information about neighborhoods’ alarm level
[*] Improved street lights
[*] You can travel between neighborhoods without going back to your hideout or pawn shop
[*] You can adjust LOD level in menu settings now
[*] Smooth speeding up walking when using stick
[*] Increased default objects' LOD distance value
[*] Quickslot mechanic improved
[*] It's now easier to spot people through window
[*] It’s easier to put an item to a quickslot
[*] Little performance improvement
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Crowbar stuck in a window
[*] Window teleports with you if you’re grabbing it
[*] Wrong wheel position after crash (in which car flies in the air and rotates) with selected lock roll option
[*] Wrong gate and camera position at St. Richie
[*] Going through some windows moves player back
[*] Player is moved up when opening shelves and other furnitures
[*] Wrong player position after leaving the VAN car
[*] Brick wall graphic glitch
[*] You can take a flashlight from you head but keep the light from your head
[*] Fence near 201 house has too big collider
[*] Disassembly jewelry minigame position in the new hideout
[*] Can't teleport on stairs
[*] Can't teleport on parking area
[*] Hard to teleport to some places
[*] Window teleports with a player if he's grabbing it
[*] Add teleport blocker to some windows to prevent from teleporting through them
[*] NPCs' cars don't have engine sound
[/list]

The next update is already underway. It will add a weather system to the game!

Best,
GameBoom VR Team

notes.title: Massive Content Update is available!
notes.content:
Hello there,

here's another big update that adds a lot of new content to the game. New story, your own house, new neighborhood, new vehicles, and... much more!

https://youtu.be/PKbV0kLs2ug

What’s new?
Changes:
[list]
[*] Content from flat Thief added! (new neighborhood, new hideout, junkyard, longer story, new tools, new car - VAN, and more!)
[*] You can teleport instead of driving a car! If driving a car makes you feel dizzy it will be great for you. The option is available in the settings
[*] Text information when lockpick is broken
[*] Small vegetation change
[*] Optimization
[*] More light in a very first tutorial place
[*] You can only go to the Pawn shop after first stole TV mission
[*] Pawn shop door are open as default state
[*] Car’s box UI will be activated only when you’re looking at it (prevents from random moving objects between backpack and the box)
[*] Added more anti aliasing levels
[*] Tabs and options in menu
[*] Climbing gloves are removed from the game
[*] It’s easier to pass fence on construction area
[*] Added information near very first camera how to spot it
[*] Small improvements in buying house story
[*] New hideout is cheaper
[*] Last mission is easier - NPC don’t hear silent sounds anymore
[*] First mission from the new patch is easier
[*] Bought information about tenants routine will show they whole day and night
[*] You can now disable controllers vibration in menu
[*] Added new graphics option to choose in menu
[*] You can change how fast time passes in menu
[*] Resolution slider shows percentage now
[*] Added reset to default SteamVR resolution button
[*] Tools collision detection improvement
[*] Added box for disassembled car parts

notes.title: Vive Cosmos support, more physics and performance optimisations!
notes.content:
Hello there!

The new patch (v 1.1.3b) is finally here! There were many changes and additions made, let me start with the most prominent ones. We finally added official support for Vive Cosmos - so now, officially all headsets and controllers on the market are supported! We believe that we fixed the performance issues on Richie St. now - playing on both neighborhoods is enjoyable. Do you like Boneworks? If so, there is a good information for you - we added more hands collisions e.g., now you can close the door using open hand, in a more phycisal way. We also improved ‘easiness’ of the game e.g. now there is also a quick slot on your backpack for crowbar, so you won’t equip it by mistake when reaching for bigger items on the floor.
If the loading screen makes you sick - there is option to use default SteamVR look.
We also fixed important issue with game resolution - it wasn’t read correctly from settings after game restart / reload. Remember, that the game resolution can only be changed in the game, changes via SteamVR won’t be applied. 

Thank you for your valuable feedback and continuous support - it means a lot! Enjoy new patch :)

Here is the full change log:

New stuff:
- Vive Cosmos support!
- Quickslot on backpack (you can attach the crowbar to the backpack)!
- Hands collide with more obstacles (like wall, fence, etc., you can hit a door by your hand to close it), this can be turned off in options
- Performance optimization (especially on Richie St.)
- Possibility to switch off fade controllers
- Possibility to switch off highlights on items
- Possibility to disable hands on items (items do not mess up when picked up from heap of items)
- Add visual extension on belt and backpack where you can store the crowbar
- Possibility to change PC mouse speed (after clicking sprocket)
- Possibility to open dev console with ‘Q’ key
- New loading room

- Possibility to change more graphics settings


Changes:
- Smaller range of possible resolutions to set

- Marker on story item disappears after the item is collected

- Disable possibility to open inventory by grabbing backpack in the center
- Disable possibility to grab backpack with Grab Pinch
- Lock axis in Movement Direction Controller mode
- Brighter night vision
- Faster cutting window glass
- Better window colliders
- Controllers bindings path

Fixes:

notes.title: New patch (v 1.1.1) is finally here!
notes.content:
Hello there,

with a little delay, but we are finally ready to push new patch to public.  In short: we fixed all urgent bugs, improved performance (~10% on GPU, on CPU - we removed big spikes during robbering and police chase) and made the game more forgiving in some aspects (it's easier to put smaller items in backpack and it's easier to carry the TV). Also we change quality settings, we admit that we overdid them - if you played above Very Low and want to keep the same quality - move one step higher e.g. if you played on Medium, set quality settings to High (more details in full change log).
As promised, we continue our work on improving game in all aspects according to your feedback (which is great and very helpful!). We are also moving to the new game engine which should be a big step in terms of performance!
Thanks for your great attitude and happy playing!

we want give you heads up and tell what currently we are working on. There is a new patch available on beta branch so you can try it over the weekend. It will be available (after additional testing on our side) on Monday evening. We fixed all urgent bugs, improved performance (~10% on GPU, on CPU - we removed big spikes during robbering and police chase) and make the game more forgiving in some aspects (it's easier to put smaller items in backpack and it's easier to carry the TV). Expect full change log on Monday together with the patch going to main branch.

We also want to thank you again for warm welcome and your understanding. We continue working on all aspects of the game. We started the migration to the newest engine and we expect that it should help with performance a lot.

notes.title: Two first patches are here! Thanks for warm welcome.
notes.content:
To all sneaky thieves!

We are really happy you welcomed us here on Steam so friendly. Thanks for all reviews and feedback, we appreciate it! Big thanks to all streamers, youtubers, and generally all content creators - you're the best (just take a look at videos at the end of this news)!

Meanwhile, we are patching the game quietly but intensively to meet all your expectations as fast as possible. This week continues to be very productive for us. Later on, we'll go back to adding new content and features to the game. Today we release second patch, fixed issues you’ve reported (thanks!). In newest patch we improved performance while driving, on some rigs the performance boost should be huge. We see your feedback and continue working on all aspects of the game including performance!

Here is change log for two (live) patches:


fix (v1.0.1):
- 107 fence
- grabbing big items
- wineglasses damageable
- static wardrobes 113
- teleport on tutorial spots

fix (v1.0.2):
- fix unbrakeable car window
- fix crashing when leaving neighborhood in green car
- car driving optimisations


Best wishes to all VR gamers!

notes.title: First gameplay video (work in progress)
notes.content:
Hello there!

I would like to share with you our first gameplay video. Remember, that it’s still work in progress :)

https://youtu.be/hZOG006CaVA

As for now, we have implemented three types of locomotion:
- arm swinging (mostly for running outside)
- head bob (for sneaking in a house, especially when holding microwave oven)
- touchpad (if you don’t want to engage to much ;p)

But it’s up to you which and when you’ll use.

And as you see in the video, you can also grab all stuff and throw. And generally interact with all objects in the game.

What’s your first impression guys? What do you expect from this game?
Share your thoughts and ideas in discussion:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1019550/discussions/0/1812044473314085617/

Many more features and videos to come! Stay tuned!
